item.title: Palace Hotel Tokyo becomes first Japanese-owned hotel to secure GSTC certification
item.description: Palace Hotel Tokyo has received certification from the Global Sustainable Tourism Council (GSTC), becoming the first Japanese-owned and managed hotel to achieve the recognition.
